subject.title: RFC 0009: align Hosted Feed v1 specifications

question: Should Hosted Feed v1 adopt this broader publisher, distribution, watch, notification, and DSSE trust contract before the linked implementation PRs land?
rationale: This RFC defines the permanent interoperability and trust boundary across multiple repositories; no mechanical documentation repair can determine the desired public protocol contract.

options.title: Approve the v1 contract after proof
options.body: Confirm the compatibility and trust direction, then require end-to-end evidence from the linked OpenClaw and ClawHub implementations before merge.

options.title: Narrow the RFC
options.body: Keep the existing core contract focused and move watch, inbox, or scalable-distribution semantics into separately sponsored addenda.

options.title: Pause pending implementation feedback
options.body: Leave the RFC open until the linked implementation work exposes concrete interoperability constraints.

recommendation.title: Approve the v1 contract after proof
recommendation.body: Confirm the compatibility and trust direction, then require end-to-end evidence from the linked OpenClaw and ClawHub implementations before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context connects this author to the RFC and the cross-referenced implementation sequence, though current-main ownership provenance could not be verified.
